scope: Successor product-decision gate after the selected V16 priority-one strategy was reproducibly falsified. This gate recommends, but does not select or authorize, the only remaining bounded choice from the frozen V15 mutually exclusive pair.

closed_priority_one.reason: The compliant generic full-frame selector has 27 unsatisfiable islands per palette at 1x and 76 per palette at asymmetric 4x. Coordinate/repair filtering is forbidden and the candidate also retains an unchecked GL mask-upload failure path.

successor_candidate.decision_question: May the product introduce a source-provenanced, non-color bridge/underpass micro-grammar that keeps both actual and predicted routes traceable at semantic overlap events without suppressing protected predicted ownership?

bounded_design_contract_if_later_selecte.semantic_event_input: Derive events only from the exact projected actual/predicted route geometry and existing source provenance. Capture ID, camera name, repair ID, probe coordinate, framebuffer color, and acceptance result are forbidden inputs.
event_normalization: Collapse raster/sample fragments into deterministic continuous route-overlap events before emitting any glyph.
Represent transverse point intersections and coaxial overlap intervals explicitly; do not classify adjacent _core/_halo from one normalized stem as two routes.
Deduplicate by ordered existing source-provenance pairs and parametric route order, never by screen-coordinate whitelist.
Fail closed with no product glyph when provenance is ambiguous, foreign, double, unowned, or event density exceeds the separately frozen design capacity.
visual_grammar: One bounded bridge/underpass micro-glyph per normalized semantic event, not one glyph per raster sample.
Both route identities remain continuously inferable using shape, interruption, casing, or bridge topology independent of hue in standard and CVD.
The glyph is renderer-only composite provenance derived from existing source pairs; it may not add, remove, reorder, or substitute authoritative source probe IDs.
No global actual-over-predicted priority, no protected predicted-body discard, no whole-route offset, and no color-only ownership cue.

unchanged: predicted yellow identity and 18/12/30 dash rhythm
actual solid identity, ticks, and endpoints
centerlines, widths, cap envelopes, offsets, and two-pass actual-then-predicted order outside the new glyph
player, elevated, overhead, broadcast, and CVD controls
camera, layout, thresholds, telemetry semantics, authority, and product exposure

minimum_cpu_static_evidence: Event inventory and deterministic digest for standard and CVD at 1x and asymmetric 4x.
Negative fixtures for same-stem core/halo, near-miss, endpoint, tick, outer rim, foreign, double, unowned, ambiguous, and excessive-density inputs.
Raster snapshots proving closed/non-color glyph topology and both-route traceability at deep dark, cyan cloth, red ball, near-white ball, same-axis, and cross-track backgrounds.
Exact 81 source order/digest, three repair IDs, dash/endpoint/tick geometry, and player/elevated/overhead controls unchanged.
Independent TA axes and a later comprehension protocol; CPU pixels alone may not claim that players understand the new grammar.

forbidden: Resume priority one, ignore unsatisfied islands, or filter by acceptance coordinates, repair IDs, camera, or capture.
Relax largest8, contrast, visible-region, ownership, source-count, or pass thresholds.
Use protected predicted suppression, global actual priority, z-order-only, color-only, camera, layout, or whole-route offset workarounds.
Add or mutate authoritative source probe IDs, the ordered 81 digest, or any of the three repair IDs.
Treat this recommendation as root product selection, production implementation authorization, readiness, GPU authorization, machine pass, or TA pass.
